evidence.section: 3.1 The coarsening of σ phase and the interface structure
evidence.quote: Previous studies [18,26] have also pointed out that the interfacial ledges provided convenience for the atomic attachment and the TCP phase coarsening. Our observation extended this understanding by revealing a structure similar to the stacking faults that appeared near the ledges.

mechanisms.name: stacking-fault-like atomic misarrangement facilitating phase transformation and coarsening

evidence.quote: It appeared that the formation of the atomic misarrangement in Fig. 2 emerged as a structural mediator between the γ' phase and σ phase, establishing local crystallographic continuity that bridges the γ'/σ interface and facilitates phase transformation.

mechanisms.name: refractory element segregation along stacking faults

evidence.quote: The refractory element atoms tend to segregate along the crystal defects such as dislocation lines and stacking faults, which is energetically favorable

mechanisms.name: stress-induced stacking fault formation accelerating coarsening

evidence.quote: indicating that external stress accelerated the TCP particle coarsening kinetics possibly through nano-scale stacking fault introduction
